design_role: Recover validated charged-product energy after field-guided exhaust while enforcing a declared He-3 residence-time target.

ledger.neutron_path: separate shielding and thermal handling; not converted by this RF-native path

acceptance_gates: He-3 residence time is at or below tau_He3_max_s for the selected state.
Product-side collection does not return an uncontrolled fraction to the plasma.
Outward terminal power is measured with calibrated V/I and reflected power.
Native conversion stages and auxiliary loads close a positive net-power ledger.
Arc, overcurrent, overtemperature, loss-of-lock, and collector faults detune/block extraction.
